pictures.name: SL1-Father-Coins
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold light, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, letters, logos or modern objects. Morning in the courtyard of a village house in old Punjab, mud-brick walls, a charpai bed, a hanging brass pot. A stern but loving middle-aged father with a grey-flecked beard and white turban places a small pile of silver coins into the open hands of his teenage son. The son, in a simple light-saffron kurta and small wrapped turban, is seen only from behind, his face never visible. Warm gold sunlight, blue shadows.

pictures.name: SL2-Hungry-Holy-Men
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold light, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, letters, logos or modern objects. A dusty country road in old Punjab under a wide banyan tree. A group of thin, tired holy men in faded ochre robes with long hair and beards rest in the shade, empty begging bowls beside them, gentle and weary, not suffering. A teenage boy in a light-saffron kurta and small wrapped turban stands before them, seen only from behind, a cloth coin pouch in his hand. Late afternoon gold light.

pictures.name: SL3-Shared-Meal
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold light, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, letters, logos or modern objects. Under the same banyan tree at evening, the holy men in ochre robes sit in a row on the ground eating warm flatbread and lentils from leaf plates, smiling, a small cooking fire and clay pots nearby. A teenage boy in a light-saffron kurta and small wrapped turban kneels, serving bread, seen only from behind. Warm firelight and gold dusk, peaceful joy.

pictures.name: SL4-Empty-Hands
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold light, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, letters, logos or modern objects. Back in the village courtyard at dusk. The middle-aged father with grey-flecked beard and white turban stands with hands on hips, frowning in disbelief. Facing him, seen only from behind, the teenage son in a light-saffron kurta and small wrapped turban holds out his empty open palms, calm. A lamp glows in a doorway, a mother watches from the shadows.

pictures.name: SL5-Emperor-In-The-Row
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold light, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, letters, logos or modern objects. A simple open langar hall in a 16th-century Punjab village. Long rows of people sit cross-legged on the floor on cotton mats: farmers, women with covered heads, laborers, and among them a richly dressed Mughal emperor in a jeweled turban and brocade robe, sitting humbly on the same floor, holding out his hands as a volunteer places a roti in them. Warm lamplight, gentle and dignified.

pictures.name: SL6-Today-Langar
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative oil painting in the same sacred style (lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold light), a modern scene, main subject in the middle. No text, letters or logos. A large modern gurdwara langar hall. Long straight rows of people of every age and background sit cross-legged on long floor mats, heads covered with scarves and handkerchiefs: a businessman, a student, a grandmother, a tourist. Volunteers in head-covering walk the rows serving rotis and dal from steel buckets into steel plates and cupped hands. Warm light, a sense of welcome.
